title: Certification Audit Builder
description: Generates complete certification audit chains from REVISION_HISTORY.md and DEFECT_LIBRARY.md data. Links Question → Certification → Recommendation → Session → Challenge → Closure for any QuestionID.

question.investigationLevel: integer — depth of investigation (1 = QID only, 2 = + surrounding QIDs, 3 = + full section)

certification.entries: array of { session, date, action } — certification timeline

auditChainModel.recommendations: array of REC-IDs linked to this QID
auditChainModel.sessions: array of { session, date } — all sessions that touched this QID
auditChainModel.challenges: array of CH-IDs raised against this QID
auditChainModel.defects: array of { id, status, severity } — DL-IDs from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md

closure.recommendation: string — next action or final disposition

dataSources.extracted: Session IDs, dates, QID references, certification actions, REC-IDs, CH-IDs, DL-IDs
DL-ID status (Open/Resolved) and severity, enrichment for audit chain defects

options.--qid: Build chain for a single QuestionID (e.g., P1-A-012). Without --qid, builds chains for all QIDs in revision history.

integrationPoints: Investigation Workbench (Board G): provides per-question audit context
Certification Review: verify a question's full audit trail before certifying
Challenge Resolution: trace which sessions and defects apply to a challenged QID
Delta Ledger: enrich delta entries with audit context
futureEnhancements: Full text search of REVISION_HISTORY.md for faster QID matching
Incremental build — only re-parse new entries since last run
Integration with question_history_builder.js for per-question timeline
Export to CSV for offline analysis
